Class WhoSessions

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.core.service.WhoSessions
public class WhoSessions extends Object
who's record of browser sessions: one per sign-in, so a person can see where they are signed in and end a session from elsewhere, and an application can end an identity's sessions.

A session is live while it is not ended and was seen within the idle timeout, the same timeout the servlet container or Spring Session uses, so a session the container dropped without saying so stops counting on its own. This service trusts its caller: it ends whatever session it is asked to, and the endpoints decide who may end which.

      public WhoSessions(SessionRecordRepository repository, WhoEventPublisher events, Clock clock, Duration idleTimeout, Duration lastSeenInterval, int purgeBatchSize, boolean autoPurge)

      Parameters:
      repository - where sessions are kept
      events - receives SessionEnded and EndedSessionsPurged
      clock - the current time
      idleTimeout - how long a session lasts without a request

    • start

      public SessionRecord start(UUID identityId, UUID credentialId, SignInMethod method, String userAgent, Instant signedInAt)
      Records a sign-in made at signedInAt, seen now. When auto-purge is on, each call then purges one batch of dead sessions; a purge that fails is logged and does not fail the sign-in.
      Parameters:
      identityId - the identity that signed in
      credentialId - the credential it signed in with
      method - how it signed in
      userAgent - the browser's User-Agent, or null
      signedInAt - when it signed in
      Returns:
      the new session
